marco: quick flag - yesterday's evening surge pushed a bunch of burst instances; we saw sustained preemptible usage for ~42m and cost spiked. proposing change to autoscale policy... 

sasha: can you paste the graphs? which region?

marco: us-west-2 primarily. CPU/GPU fill rate jumped, and we hit the burst cap then started borrowing preemptible nodes. attached simplified metrics: peak qps 12k, avg seq len 220.

eli: rough ask: what's current burst cap config? I remember it's 40% of pool with 10min holdback.

karen: yep that's right. 40% burst cap + 10m cooldown. But the holdback doesn't survive back-to-back surges.

marco: proposal: move to a hybrid guardrail: (a) per-cluster burst cap 30% max, (b) global soft-reserve window that guarantees 15% steady capacity for 20 minutes after a burst, (c) hysteresis: scale-down only after 12m stable below threshold. snippet:
```yaml
burst_cap: 0.30
reserve_after_burst: 0.15
reserve_window_minutes: 20
scale_down_hysteresis_minutes: 12
``` 

leo: that makes sense. It preserves a steady pool for critical tail latency. How does this affect throughput/cost in sims?

autoscale-bot: sim-run completed for policy v2-hybrid on sample workload 'nov-traffic-2025'

autoscale-bot: results: median latency +8ms, p99 improved 120ms -> 95ms, GPU hours +3.4%, preemptible hours -48%, cost delta -1.2% overall

sasha: good tradeoff. slight GPU hour increase but cuts preemptible churn and p99 — wins for reliability

eli: two questions: (1) can we make reserve_window adaptive by surge frequency? (2) add labels so Dedicated customers can opt out

marco: yes to both. adaptive idea: increase reserve_window by 5m for each surge within 1h, cap at 40m. Will add customer opt-out flag: dedicated_reserved: false|true

karen: ops runbook updates needed: how to manually override during regional outages. I'll draft.

leo: timeline? if we merge RC today I can promote to staging and run 48h canary.

marco: plan: merge tomorrow AM, 48h staging, canary to prod next Wed if stable. I'll file a PR with config + sim artifacts.

sasha: please add a dashboard tile for reserve-window utilization and alert on reserve starvation (<10% for >5m)

marco: noted. filing dashboards + runbook.

karen: thanks. tagging @oncall for FYI :wave:

eli: nice proposal — thanks marco.
